en.what_title: What I do for a leadership team

what.h: Get decisions out to the company
what.p: I turn CEO and COO priorities into company-wide messages: who hears them, when, in which language, and what managers need to pass them on. Each one goes out with a manager briefing, FAQs and a named person for questions.

I agree the wording with Legal, HR, Finance, Investor Relations and the country leads on the most sensitive announcements: a stock market listing, new roles and reporting lines, acquired companies joining the group.
A weekly leadership update that the Board also receives, a monthly company newsletter, town halls and a global intranet, so people hear things from the company before they hear them anywhere else.
I have led a team across Italy and France and managed agencies and suppliers, Brunswick included, keeping an eye on cost and quality.

points: Joined in the company's first year and built the communications function as it grew to more than 900 people in Italy, France, the UK and the US.
Employee communications for the Nasdaq listing in September 2026, with Legal, Finance and Investor Relations.
Owned the brand across the group, brought acquired companies into one identity and oversaw the 2024 relaunch of the website.
Organised the company's presence at PHYSOR 2026 in Turin, 550 delegates from 32 countries, and briefed the CEO for talks and national media.

it.what_title: Cosa faccio per un team di leadership

what.h: Portare le decisioni a tutta l'azienda
what.p: Trasformo le priorità di CEO e COO in messaggi per tutta l'azienda: chi li riceve, quando, in quale lingua e cosa serve ai manager per trasmetterli. Ognuno parte con un briefing per i manager, le FAQ e una persona di riferimento per le domande.

Concordo i testi con Legal, HR, Finance, Investor Relations e i country manager sugli annunci più delicati: una quotazione in borsa, nuovi ruoli e linee di riporto, società acquisite che entrano nel gruppo.

Un aggiornamento settimanale della leadership che riceve anche il CdA, una newsletter aziendale mensile, town hall e una intranet globale, perché le persone sappiano le cose dall'azienda prima che da chiunque altro.

what.h: Guidare un team e le agenzie
what.p: Ho guidato un team tra Italia e Francia e gestito agenzie e fornitori, Brunswick compresa, con attenzione a costi e qualità.
